title: Data Science Side Projects | Dylan Poulsen, Libby Heeren, Isabella Velasquez | Data Science Lab
description:
The Data Science Lab is a live weekly call. Register at pos.it/dslab! Discord invites go out each week on lives calls. We'd love to have you!

The Lab is an open, messy space for learning and asking questions. Think of it like pair coding with a friend or two. Learn something new, and share what you know to help others grow.

On this call, Libby Heeren is joined by Dylan Poulsen and Isabella Velásquez for a community project showcase, where each host shares a passion project they made just for the ✨joy✨ of it.

Dylan tells the story of the "onion constant," the recreational math he did to find the mathematically optimal way to cut an onion, which somehow ended up in the New York Times, The Pudding, and on Hacker News 😮 Libby shares the year-and-a-half journey of building her Ellsworth Kelly-inspired Shiny app in R (mess and mistakes included) as a love letter to working out loud. And Isabella walks through how she and her brother ported their favorite RStudio theme into a Positron color theme. This is a celebration of doing things for fun, sharing your work before it's fully polished, and the community that we share it with!

Hosting crew from Posit: Libby Heeren, Isabella Velasquez
